caption: The drawing depicts an architectural interior scene featuring three prominent red arches with alternating white segments and blue decorative elements hanging below each arch. The arches are supported by red columns with blue capitals. Below the central arch is a semi-circular niche with a light gray interior and an ornate frame decorated with red lines, blue scrollwork, a blue feather or palm motif, and topped with a small red cross. The lower half of the wall has a diamond pattern in red and white, bordered by a blue horizontal line at the top. A series of small red finials, each topped with tiny crosses, line the blue border above the niche and along the horizontal surface extending from the left to the center. To the left of the scene, there is a stylized wall decoration, resembling a vessel or lamp with a red outline and spikes radiating outward. The floor is illustrated with a diagonal brick pattern in shades of brown. The overall color palette comprises muted reds, pale blues, light browns, and white. The drawing is signed "Frank G. Baires" in the lower right corner.
title: Wall Painting and Baptismal Niche
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
